question: Which of the following is true about the second frigate of Project 1135.6 named ‘Tavasya’?

options.text: It has a displacement of approximately 4,500 tons
It is the first frigate of the follow‑on order
It was built in Russia and later transferred to India
It was launched at Goa Shipyard Limited on 22 March 2025

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Project 1135.6**: This is a series of frigates constructed under an Indo-Russian collaboration, primarily meant for the Indian Navy. These ships are equipped with advanced weapon systems and sensors to ensure operational readiness.
 
• **Tavasya**: The second frigate under Project 1135.6 was named ‘Tavasya’. It is part of India’s effort to bolster naval capabilities and enhance maritime security.
 
• The frigate was launched at **Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL)** on **22 March 2025**. GSL is one of the leading shipyards in India responsible for constructing modern naval vessels. *Hence, option 4 is correct.*
